issues.description: Module-level monkey-patch of genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE mutates a third-party SDK's private global at import time
issues.detail: Reaching into google-genai's private underscore-prefixed module to mutate a shared global on import re-tunes the SDK for every consumer of pipecat in the process. The author's own comment calls it a 'temporary hack'. Configure the SDK via its public HttpOptions/client API, pin the dep, or file upstream.

issues.description: image.tobytes() declares format='RGB' without converting, breaking non-RGB PIL modes (RGBA, P, L)
issues.detail: Pillow decodes PNG in whatever mode the source uses. Calling tobytes() without image.convert('RGB') while labeling the frame format='RGB' produces a buffer whose size and layout disagree with the declared format. Downstream renderers will get garbled pixels or crash. Convert explicitly or propagate image.mode as the frame format.

issues.description: Default model bump from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent breaking change buried in a feature PR
issues.detail: Callers relying on the constructor default get different latency, pricing, and thinking-budget behavior on upgrade with no deprecation path. The change belongs in its own patch, called out as a breaking default, not bundled into the image-generation feature.

issues.description: Image-model detection via substring match on model name is a fragile, undocumented predicate
issues.detail: 'if "image" in self._model_name' couples a behavioral invariant to a Google naming convention. Any future non-image model with 'image' in its name will trigger the branch incorrectly. Extract a documented is_image_generation_model() predicate or use an explicit capability flag.

issues.description: Emitting OutputImageRawFrame from GoogleLLMService strengthens the service contract without restating it
issues.detail: The LLM service supertype contract is text+tool-call streaming. Pushing image frames mid-stream forces downstream consumers to accept frame types they weren't written for. Document which model subtypes produce image frames and what ordering guarantees hold relative to LLMTextFrame and aggregator boundaries.

issues.description: No error handling around Image.open of server-returned bytes can abort the entire context-processing loop
issues.detail: If the model returns malformed inline_data, PIL raises UnidentifiedImageError and the whole streaming loop dies. Wrap in try/except, log the failure, and continue processing remaining parts so one bad image part does not take down the pipeline.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR needs work before merge. Two concrete bugs ship with the feature: a self-described 'temporary hack' that monkey-patches a private google-genai global at import time, and an Image.tobytes() call that declares RGB without converting non-RGB PIL modes. A silent default-model bump from 2.0-flash to 2.5-flash is bundled into a feature PR and should be split out. Substring-sniffing 'image' in the model name encodes a Google naming convention as an invariant and should be a documented predicate. Emitting OutputImageRawFrame from the LLM service also strengthens the service contract without restating it, and unguarded PIL decoding of server bytes can abort the streaming loop.
